references.text: Describes the two gold rings that were attached to the breastplate, which is part of the same instructions regarding the construction of the breastplate.
Continues the description of how the breastplate was to be fastened to the ephod with gold rings and blue cords.
Parallel text describing the execution of these instructions—the two gold rings that were made and attached to the ends of the breastplate toward the ephod.
A similar construction using gold rings that was used on the ark of the covenant, showing a pattern in the tabernacle's equipment.
Describes the ephod to which the breastplate was to be fastened, providing context for the placement of the rings.
